title: AI-Based Smart Attendance System
description: A face-recognition based attendance system that automatically marks student attendance from classroom camera feed and logs it to a spreadsheet.

title: AI Resume Screener with NLP
description: Ranks resumes against a job description using keyword extraction and semantic similarity scoring — a great capstone for the Applied ML course.

title: Campus FAQ Chatbot
description: A simple chatbot that answers common student queries about timetables, fees and events using intent matching.

title: Command-Line Expense Tracker
description: A beginner-friendly CLI tool to log, categorize and visualize personal expenses — the flagship project of the Python Zero to Hero course.

title: Automated File Organizer
description: Automatically sorts files in a folder into categorized subfolders based on file type — a practical automation starter project.

title: Student Record Management System
description: A desktop application to manage student records with a SQL database backend and a simple GUI, ideal for the SQL for Engineers course.

title: Smart Dustbin with Ultrasonic Sensor
description: An automatic lid-opening dustbin using an ultrasonic sensor and a servo motor controlled by an 8051 microcontroller.

title: Temperature Monitoring & Logging System
description: Reads temperature data via an LM35 sensor, displays it on an LCD and logs readings to a PC over UART serial communication.

title: IR-Based Home Appliance Automation
description: Control home appliances using an infrared remote interfaced with an 8051 microcontroller and relay switching circuit.

title: 4-bit ALU Design in Verilog
description: RTL design and simulation of a 4-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit supporting addition, subtraction and logical operations, with a complete testbench.

title: Traffic Light Controller (FSM in Verilog)
description: A classic finite state machine implementation controlling a 4-way traffic signal, ideal for learning FSM design in RTL.

title: UART Transmitter-Receiver in Verilog
description: A synthesizable UART transmitter and receiver module design with configurable baud rate, tested on an FPGA development board.

title: Dual-Axis Solar Tracker
description: A solar panel that automatically orients itself toward maximum sunlight using LDR sensors and dual-axis servo control.

title: Active Noise Cancellation — MATLAB Simulation
description: Simulates an adaptive LMS filter-based active noise cancellation system, connected to ongoing research interests in signal processing.
